rainfall_1h_mm.physical_meaning: Short-term peak precipitation accumulation in the preceding 1 hour
rainfall_1h_mm.source: ERA5-Land hourly precipitation (ECMWF via Open-Meteo Archive / In-situ Automatic Rain Gauges)
rainfall_1h_mm.derivation: Direct 1-hour sum of precipitation flux (hourly total liquid water equivalent mm)
rainfall_1h_mm.relevance: Key trigger for flash floods, debris flows, and sudden urban/ravine inundations.

rainfall_3h_mm.physical_meaning: Medium-term antecedent precipitation accumulation over 3 hours
rainfall_3h_mm.source: ERA5-Land hourly precipitation (ECMWF via Open-Meteo Archive / Station Telemetry)
rainfall_3h_mm.derivation: Rolling 3-hour backward sum of hourly precipitation
rainfall_3h_mm.relevance: Captures meso-convective cloudburst burst durations typical of Himalayan valleys.

rainfall_6h_mm.source: ERA5-Land hourly precipitation (ECMWF via Open-Meteo Archive / IMD AWS)
rainfall_6h_mm.derivation: Rolling 6-hour backward sum of hourly precipitation
rainfall_6h_mm.relevance: Integrates sustained frontal rainfall events that begin saturating mid-altitude hillslopes.

rainfall_24h_mm.physical_meaning: Daily antecedent rainfall accumulation over 24 hours
rainfall_24h_mm.source: ERA5-Land hourly precipitation (ECMWF via Open-Meteo Archive / IMD Daily Gauges)
rainfall_24h_mm.derivation: Rolling 24-hour backward sum of hourly precipitation
rainfall_24h_mm.relevance: Governs catchment wetness and baseflow rise in regional river channels.

rainfall_72h_mm.source: ERA5-Land hourly precipitation (ECMWF via Open-Meteo Archive)
rainfall_72h_mm.derivation: Rolling 72-hour backward sum of hourly precipitation
rainfall_72h_mm.relevance: Determines deep soil saturation, prolonged groundwater replenishment, and regional catchment priming.

soil_saturation_pct.physical_meaning: Topsoil volumetric saturation level (0-7 cm layer)
soil_saturation_pct.source: ERA5-Land volumetric soil water layer 1 (swvl1) / Field Soil Sensors
soil_saturation_pct.derivation: Normalized as percentage of soil field capacity: (swvl1 / 0.47) * 100.0, clipped [0, 100]
soil_saturation_pct.relevance: Controls Hortonian overland flow: when topsoil reaches 100%, infiltration ceases and rainfall converts directly to surface runoff.

deep_soil_saturation_pct.physical_meaning: Subsurface soil volumetric saturation level (7-28 cm root layer)
deep_soil_saturation_pct.derivation: Normalized as percentage of soil field capacity: (swvl2 / 0.47) * 100.0, clipped [0, 100]
deep_soil_saturation_pct.relevance: Controls Dunian saturation-excess overland flow and landslide/debris-flow pore-pressure triggers.

temperature_c.derivation: Direct instantaneous temperature in degrees Celsius (converted from Kelvin: T - 273.15)
temperature_c.relevance: Affects snowmelt rates in high-altitude cryospheric catchments and atmospheric moisture-holding capacity.

relative_humidity_pct.source: ERA5-Land dewpoint temperature and air temperature (ECMWF)
relative_humidity_pct.derivation: Magnus-Tetens psychrometric calculation: 100 * (exp((17.625 * Td) / (243.04 + Td)) / exp((17.625 * T) / (243.04 + T)))
relative_humidity_pct.relevance: Indicator of air mass saturation, cloud deck base, and convective thunderstorm potential.

surface_pressure_hpa.derivation: Direct barometric pressure converted from Pa to hPa (P / 100.0)
surface_pressure_hpa.relevance: Rapid barometric pressure drops signal approaching cyclonic depressions, western disturbances, or monsoonal lows.

wind_speed_kmh.derivation: Vector magnitude converted to km/h: sqrt(u10^2 + v10^2) * 3.6
wind_speed_kmh.relevance: Drives orographic windward moisture convergence and mechanical slope turbulence in deep gorges.

elevation_m.physical_meaning: Station or settlement altitude above mean sea level
elevation_m.source: Copernicus DEM 30m / SRTM 1 Arc-Second Digital Elevation Model
elevation_m.derivation: Bilinear spatial interpolation from 30m DEM at station/village lat/lon coordinate
elevation_m.relevance: Governs precipitation phase (rain vs snow), temperature lapse rates, and potential gravitational energy of runoff.

catchment_slope_deg.derivation: Horn's slope algorithm computed over 500m catchment buffer around station in degrees
catchment_slope_deg.relevance: Controls runoff velocity and concentration time: steep Himalayan slopes accelerate flash flood wave formation.

dist_to_river_m.physical_meaning: Perpendicular distance to nearest active river channel centerline
dist_to_river_m.source: HydroSHEDS / OpenStreetMap River Networks / Survey of India Hydrology
dist_to_river_m.derivation: Euclidean planar distance from station coordinate to nearest stream vector geometry
dist_to_river_m.relevance: Direct spatial exposure to overbank riverine flooding and channel boundary surge.

upstream_drainage_sqkm.physical_meaning: Total upstream watershed catchment area contributing runoff to the reach
upstream_drainage_sqkm.source: HydroSHEDS 15 Arc-Second Flow Accumulation / CWC Basin Maps
upstream_drainage_sqkm.derivation: Flow direction and accumulation accumulation raster pixel integration converted to square kilometers
upstream_drainage_sqkm.relevance: Scales peak flood discharge: larger drainage areas sustain higher volume floods, while small headwaters produce sudden flashy spikes.
